set.body:
Objective
Reproducible Docker-pinned generators emitting both container fixtures and decoded shared fixtures.

Authority and inputs
Plan: docs/plans/spatial-transform-parity.md (Phase 4 layout). Reader map: docs/plans/spatial-transform-parity-epic.md. References: ~/code/neurotransform (kernel/format parity), ~/code/neurofunctor (graph/operator parity). R packages are references, not APIs to copy.

Owner role and starting seams
tools/transform; transform test resources and generated shared sources. Bounded candidates, not reservations; reserve exact paths when beginning.

Prerequisite packets
Native mote blocking edges are authoritative; see docs/plans/spatial-transform-parity-epic.md.

Acceptance
1. Pinned images per tool; manifest.json schema (versions, commands, SHA-256).
2. Generators emit text/binary oracles as generated shared sources and container oracles as decoded TransformSource fixtures readable on JS.
3. JVM test asserts decoded shared fixtures equal the JVM container reader's output from the real files.
4. Symmetry rules enforced: oblique, anisotropic, non-square, shear; >= 8 asymmetric points.

Verification
Regeneration reproduces hashes; equivalence test passes.

Scope and handoff
Implement only this packet plus its owner-local tests/docs. Respect the authority ledger (docs/plans/image-module-unification-hardening.md) and the imageAlgebraBoundaryCheck forbidden names (no SpatialMorphism/Affine3DMorphism/IdentityMorphism/DenseFieldInverse/JacobianField/JacobianMode etc.). Generic transform/warp math belongs in reframe4s, geometry in image4s, linear algebra in Gale; ScalaFIM keeps neuroimaging policy and adapters. Every change compiles and passes on JVM and JS, run in bounded sbt batches (never scalafimTestAll in one shot); keep scalafimCompileAll warning-clean. Stage with explicit pathspecs (concurrent writers share this worktree). No push, release or foreign-store mutation. At handoff attach exact revisions, commands and results, oracle manifest hashes and declared caveats; unresolved criteria keep the packet open.
set.title: STP-P4.01: Oracle generator infrastructure and decoded shared fixtures
